newsitem.title: USA: Stone Energy well tests for natgas, oil.
newsitem.headline: Stone Energy well tests for natgas, oil.

text.p: Stone Energy Corp said on Monday that its discovery well at the South Pelto Block 23 field, offshore Louisiana, tested at 700 barrels of oil and 16.2 million cubic feet of gas per day.
For a limited duration, the OCS-G 1238 No. 24 well tested at a flowing tubing pressure of 9,530 pounds per square inch on a 17/64-inch choke, Stone Energy said.
The well was tested from a 20-foot interval in the deepest productive sand encountered by the well from perforations between 17,830 and 17,850 feet of total measured depth, the company said.
Stone Energy said two additional wells are planned for the first half of 1997 to further delineate the extent of the discovery.

First production from this discovery is expected by the fourth quarter of 1997, and the design of the "D" Platform and facilities to produce from the new area is currently in progress, said Stone Energy, which owns a 98 percent working interest in the block.
